study.question: Authorized supplied receipts, not new runs: baseline-din macro AUC 0.8099233880793816. Round 0: g0-r0000-behavior_slots 0.8136963424139607 and g0-r0000-count_scaled_slots 0.8142997578652308 both trail g0-r0000-pooled_slots 0.8166562307761027; g0-r0000-recency_slots reaches 0.818380494088827. Round 1 grouping improves both cells (grouped_recency minus replica_recency = 0.0009203016898680; grouped_pooled minus replica_pooled = 0.0036908999393937), but the factorial interaction is negative, -0.0027705982495257. Round 2 g0-r0002-atomic_fields 0.8195094316643636 exceeds coordinate_partition 0.8189680279483766 but trails replica_seven 0.8197867254783204 by 0.0002772938139568; intact field units are not supported over the replica rival in this implementation. All 12 supplied trials succeeded; no failed training receipt is present. Candidate diagnostics say not_requested, which is not evidence of passed numerical gates. Current incumbent code forms seven identical scaled copies per temporal summary before identities; changing field boundaries after pooling cannot recover discarded event relationships. This observed code bottleneck, rather than a source-card ranking, motivates pre-pooling event-group units. Incumbent history slices: empty 0.7160178933 (6444 examples, only 13 buy positives), length 1-16 0.7706764825, 17-64 0.7967472998, >64 0.8398873120. Slice performance is confounded by prevalence and difficulty; it does not show longer histories cause improvement. All conclusions are single-recipe/single-seed and validation-only; no paired predictions/user identifiers are supplied for clustered uncertainty estimation. Question: Can seven overlapping target-field-relation event groups per temporal segment supply complementary history evidence beyond identical whole-summary replicas, and is any benefit attributable only to explicit match counts?
study.hypothesis: Hard relation masks applied BEFORE the inherited target-conditioned weighted sum preserve different complete event-value distributions, whereas field partitioning AFTER the sum cannot recover them. The seven units are global plus one equality group for each of item_id, cate_id, campaign_id, customer_id, brand and price_bucket, in inherited feature order. Each selected event retains all six item-field embeddings and its historical action embedding. Cross each relation with the unchanged global plus four visible-rank quartiles. Match only visible positive non-padding encoded IDs; do not match actions or task labels. This is a structural representation hypothesis, not a demonstrated information-theoretic or causal mechanism. Explicit unweighted match counts may explain an improvement and require their own factorial factor. Category/brand relations are plausible under the benchmark auxiliary-label construction, but this cannot establish advertisement-specific attribution or deployment-time validity.

New units retain whole selected event values rather than splitting a shared pooled field vector; no HiFormer hierarchical heterogeneous blocks/task-token readout are added.

Only the authorized author README is available; publisher full paper is blocked. study.proposed_difference: Keep all trainable modules from g0-r0002-replica_seven. Replace the content assignment to its 35 summary tokens with overlapping target-equality event membership before summation, optionally replacing each token count scalar with its relation-specific log1p count/log(101). Use the identical inherited unnormalized DIN scalar event weights in all groups; scale every content vector by 1/sqrt(7), retain the unsplit global DIN bypass and the five original temporal count readouts. A 2x2 design crosses content_mode relation/replicas with count_mode relation/temporal. Every cell has identical token count, trainable shapes and initialization order; relation-content arms do extra pooling work, which must be measured. Validity always uses temporal occupancy, including zero-match groups, to avoid leaking explicit group occupancy through the attention mask. The content-only name means removal of the explicit relation-count channel, NOT removal of implicit count information: sum magnitude, cancellation and zero-match content remain count-dependent. Fixed 1/sqrt(7) scaling is inherited, not samplewise norm matching; overlapping groups can change total content energy. No learned-query, generic hard-search, equality-feature or tokenization priority claim is made; novelty remains unverified.

All cells retain the same trainable parameter count and 35 summary tokens. Relation-content pooling is expected to add modest runtime/memory; this is a prediction, not a measured cost result. No equal-compute claim follows from equal parameters.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve at least 6000 seconds for host gates, failed attempts, a count-matched deterministic within-segment selection replacement if promising, and paired repetitions of consequential cells. Host must authorize repetition seeds; this proposal does not change the frozen seed or recipe. Freeze source/config/checkpoint hashes, selected models, controls and commands before assessment. cost_plan.stop_rule: Proposal phase only: do not train or install. Host gates must establish finite four-task [B,1] probabilities, BF16 forward/backward and masked-input invariance on empty/mixed/full histories, and full-unit cost before interpretation. After gates, execute the four planned cells, preserving all charges and original receipts. Stop/adapt at the fixed trial cap/campaign deadline, integrity failure, or when no useful admissible experiment plus necessary reserves fits; never extend the budget. If no improvement, retain incumbent and document negative outcome.
